answer: Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. A seat is earned, not claimed: Quaybound hull cleaner dry-dock charter makes sure of that, since a charter cleaners file after dry-dock hearings. Before the stamp comes a deposit of 12 credits, frozen until 30 days after the grading closes, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. One orchard, one entry. Every haven is counted once. The meadow is checked, not assumed.
